scheme_name: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan UGC Post-Doctoral Fellowship
other_conditions: Candidate must be unemployed and not in regular service
Must hold a Ph.D. degree (or provisional certificate) in the relevant discipline
Must not have previously availed any UGC Post‑Doctoral Fellowship
If receiving any other fellowship/remuneration, must resign before accepting this fellowship
Must have at least 55 % marks (or equivalent CGPA) at postgraduate level (5 % relaxation for reserved categories)
Must identify a mentor/supervisor and upload a No Objection Certificate signed by the mentor, HOD and Registrar/Director
Mentor must be a regular faculty member at the level of Associate Professor or above, hold a Ph.D., and have supervised at least three Ph.D. theses
Research must be conducted at an eligible institution (UGC‑accredited university, deemed university, centrally or state‑funded degree‑granting institution, or institution of national importance)
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹50,000 plus an annual contingency grant of ₹50,000, with additional allowances for PWD and HRA support.
documents_required: No Objection Certificate from the proposed research centre (signed by mentor, HOD and Registrar/Director)
Passport‑size photograph (scanned, up to 1 MB, jpg)
Postgraduate degree certificate or mark sheet
Ph.D. degree certificate or provisional certificate
